title: Always deployed
description: Give every build a live URL. Release and roll back through Zephyr Cloud without rebuilding your application.

title: SaaSpocalypse
description: Build and own the software your team needs. Review each build live and control releases with Zephyr Cloud.

title: Composable enterprise
description: Let each team build and release its own modules while delivering one product through Module Federation and Zephyr Cloud.

title: Agents deploy
description: Review running software from every agent attempt. Let agents deploy and keep production releases in human hands.

title: Kill the release train
description: Release each team’s work when it is ready. Replace coordinated release windows with independent releases through Zephyr Cloud.

title: Rollback isn't a rebuild
description: Roll production back to a build that is already deployed. Recover through Zephyr Cloud without rebuilding or uploading again.

title: One line
description: Add Zephyr to your existing bundler for live build URLs, environments, releases and rollback.

title: Cloud is a commodity
description: Deploy the same build across cloud providers. Choose a cloud per environment and move without rebuilding your application.

title: Ship everywhere
description: Release federated features across web, React Native and desktop applications through Zephyr Cloud.

title: Stop making users wait
description: Deliver JavaScript and UI updates to React Native, Electron and Tauri applications without waiting for a new store release.

title: Ship the part, not the app
description: Release individual app features through Module Federation and Zephyr Cloud. Update one remote without rebuilding the whole app.
